demo-conv-ratelimit.patch:
diff --git a/src/ratelimit/tokenBucket.ts b/src/ratelimit/tokenBucket.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..72bc1f0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/ratelimit/tokenBucket.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import type { Redis } from '../infra/redis'
+
+const TOKEN_BUCKET_SCRIPT = `
+local tokens = tonumber(redis.call('HGET', KEYS[1], 'tokens')) or tonumber(ARGV[1])
+local updated_at = tonumber(redis.call('HGET', KEYS[1], 'updated_at')) or tonumber(ARGV[3])
+local elapsed = math.max(0, tonumber(ARGV[3]) - updated_at)
+tokens = math.min(tonumber(ARGV[1]), tokens + elapsed * tonumber(ARGV[2]) / 1000)
+local allowed = tokens >= 1
+if allowed then tokens = tokens - 1 end
+redis.call('HSET', KEYS[1], 'tokens', tokens, 'updated_at', ARGV[3])
+return { allowed and 1 or 0, math.floor(tokens) }
+`
+
+export async function consumeTokenBucket(redis: Redis, key: string, capacity: number, refill: number, nowMs: number) {
+  const [allowed, remaining] = await redis.eval(TOKEN_BUCKET_SCRIPT, [key], [capacity, refill, nowMs])
+  return { allowed: allowed === 1, limit: capacity, remaining }
+}
diff --git a/src/middleware/rateLimit.ts b/src/middleware/rateLimit.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..bc912be
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/middleware/rateLimit.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+import { consumeTokenBucket } from '../ratelimit/tokenBucket'
+
+export function rateLimit(deps: RateLimitDeps): Middleware {
+  return async (request, next) => {
+    const apiKeyId = request.context.apiKey.id
+    const decision = await consumeTokenBucket(deps.redis, `ratelimit:${apiKeyId}`, deps.capacity, deps.refill, deps.now())
+    request.response.headers.set('RateLimit-Limit', String(decision.limit))
+    request.response.headers.set('RateLimit-Remaining', String(decision.remaining))
+    if (!decision.allowed) return request.json({ error: { code: 'rate_limit_exceeded', requestId: request.id } }, 429)
+    return next()
+  }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import { AreaChart, ReferenceArea } from '../ui/charts'
+import { useQuery } from '../hooks/useQuery'
+import type { BillingPeriod } from '../billing/types'
+
+export function UsageGraph({ accountId, period, periodsBack }: {
+  accountId: string
+  period: BillingPeriod
+  periodsBack: number
+}) {
+  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery(`/api/usage/${accountId}?periods=${periodsBack}`)
+  if (isLoading) return <AreaChart.Skeleton />
+  if (!data?.days.length) return <AreaChart.Empty label="No usage yet this period" />
+  return (
+    <AreaChart data={data.days} x="day" y="units" unit="requests">
+      <ReferenceArea from={period.start} to={period.end} label="Current period" />
+    </AreaChart>
+  )
+}
diff --git a/src/db/queries/dailyUsage.ts b/src/db/queries/dailyUsage.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..88b1ef6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/db/queries/dailyUsage.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm'
+import { db } from '../client'
+import { usageRollups } from '../schema/billing'
+
+/** Daily totals from the hourly rollups, oldest first. */
+export async function dailyUsage(accountId: string, from: Date, to: Date) {
+  return db
+    .select({ day: sql<string>`date_trunc('day', ${usageRollups.hour})`, units: sql<number>`sum(${usageRollups.units})` })
+    .from(usageRollups)
+    .where(sql`${usageRollups.accountId} = ${accountId} and ${usageRollups.hour} >= ${from} and ${usageRollups.hour} < ${to}`)
+    .groupBy(sql`1`)
+    .orderBy(sql`1`)
+}

+import { Router } from 'express'
+import { dailyUsage } from '../db/queries/dailyUsage'
+import { periodsBefore } from '../billing/periods'
+
+export const usageRouter = Router()
+
+usageRouter.get('/:accountId', async (req, res) => {
+  const periods = periodsBefore(new Date(), Number(req.query.periods ?? 3))
+  const days = await dailyUsage(req.params.accountId, periods.from, periods.to)
+  res.json({ days, period: periods.current })
+})
